research.what: Network operators trial AI to generate and test reinforcement options on digital twins.

change.what: AI proposes and stress-tests most network reinforcement plans, with engineers approving. Estimated.

milestones.note: Could compress planning, but consenting and supply chains still set the pace.

milestones.title: Digital substations across GB

research.what: IEC 61850 standard for digital substation communications is published.

change.what: Most GB transmission substations use fully digital protection and control. Estimated.

milestones.note: A conventional, asset-replacement-paced transition with big cyber implications.

milestones.title: Multi-day iron-air storage in GB

research.what: Iron-air battery research and first US deployments.

change.what: Multi-day iron-air storage operating on the GB system. Estimated.

milestones.note: Depends on market support for long-duration storage.

milestones.title: AI designs whole chips

research.what: AI tools take on chip floorplanning and verification.

change.what: Leading chips designed end to end with AI agents and human sign-off. Estimated.

milestones.note: Design time falls; fabs and lithography still set the pace.

milestones.title: 2D-material transistors

research.what: University research on single-atom-thick semiconductors such as molybdenum disulphide.

change.what: 2D-material transistors in commercial chips. Estimated.

milestones.note: A conventional materials-to-fab journey.

milestones.title: Photonic AI accelerators in data centres

research.what: Start-ups and universities develop chips that compute with light.

change.what: Photonic accelerators deployed for AI workloads at scale. Estimated.

milestones.note: Could cut the energy demand of AI data centres.

milestones.title: Autonomous software engineering

research.what: AI agents begin completing multi-step software engineering tasks.

change.what: Most enterprise software changes built, tested and deployed by AI agents under human review. Estimated.

milestones.note: Assurance and supply chain security become the limiting factors.

milestones.title: AI research scientists

research.what: AI systems that propose hypotheses, run experiments and write papers.

change.what: AI systems routinely lead discoveries that pass peer review. Estimated.

milestones.note: If this lands, every other field’s gap could shrink.

milestones.title: Certified AI in safety-critical systems

research.what: Standards bodies and regulators begin work on assuring AI in safety-critical use.

change.what: AI certified to act in safety-critical energy, transport and health systems. Estimated.

milestones.note: A regulatory journey, so it follows conventional timelines.

milestones.title: Useful quantum chemistry simulation

research.what: Early quantum algorithms for chemistry and materials, helped by AI decoders.

change.what: Quantum computers deliver commercially useful chemistry results, such as battery or catalyst design. Estimated.

milestones.note: Would feed back into energy materials.

milestones.title: Optical clocks for national timing

research.what: Optical lattice clocks are invented.

change.what: Optical clocks underpin national time and grid timing. Estimated.

milestones.note: More resilient timing for networks if satellite signals are jammed.

research.what: Post-quantum standardisation begins.

change.what: NCSC’s target date for completing migration to post-quantum cryptography.

milestones.note: Long-lived operational technology is the hardest part.

milestones.title: Autonomous cyber defence in OT

research.what: AI agents for detection, investigation and response in industrial networks.

change.what: AI agents contain most OT cyber incidents automatically, within safety limits. Estimated.

milestones.note: Attackers will use the same capabilities.

milestones.title: Quantum network links between cities

research.what: Entanglement distribution research and national quantum networks.

change.what: Commercial quantum network links between UK cities. Estimated.

milestones.note: Mainly for specialised security and timing.

milestones.title: AI-designed battery chemistry in mass-market cars

research.what: AI screens millions of candidate battery materials.

change.what: A mass-market car battery uses a chemistry found with AI. Estimated.

milestones.note: Discovery fast; qualification and manufacturing slow.

milestones.title: Recyclable wind turbine blades at scale

research.what: Resin chemistries that allow blades to be separated and recycled.

change.what: Recyclable blades are standard on new wind farms. Estimated.

milestones.note: A conventional industrial adoption curve.

milestones.title: Commercial space stations

research.what: NASA funds private space station designs to replace the ISS.

change.what: Commercial stations host crews after the ISS retires. Estimated.

milestones.note: Government as customer again.

milestones.title: In-orbit manufacturing

research.what: Start-ups test manufacturing semiconductors and materials in microgravity.

change.what: Commercial products made in orbit are returned and sold. Estimated.

milestones.note: AI-run autonomous factories make this more feasible.

milestones.title: Robots doing routine network field work

research.what: Robot foundation models and legged robots for inspection.

change.what: Robots carry out routine substation and line maintenance tasks under remote supervision. Estimated.

milestones.note: Safety certification and unions will shape the pace.

milestones.title: Driverless freight on UK motorways

research.what: Autonomous truck trials and the Automated Vehicles Act.

change.what: Driverless lorries operate commercially on UK motorways. Estimated.

milestones.note: Regulation and liability set the pace.

milestones.title: AI-discovered antibiotic approved

change.what: An antibiotic discovered by AI is approved. Estimated.

milestones.note: Discovery was fast; clinical trials are not.

milestones.title: AI virtual cell models in drug trials

research.what: Large AI models that simulate how cells respond to drugs.

change.what: Virtual cell models used routinely to design and shorten clinical trials. Estimated.

milestones.note: This is where AI could finally compress the slowest part of medicine.

milestones.title: Post-quantum cryptography migration mandates

research.what: Shor's quantum algorithm showed that widely used public-key cryptography could be broken by a large quantum computer. This prompted the search for quantum-resistant replacements, which NIST standardised in 2024.

change.what: NIST's final IR 8547 roadmap (27 Oct 2026) and the NSA's 1 Oct 2026 announcement under EO 14412 set deadlines. New national security systems must support quantum-resistant algorithms from 2027, legacy systems are phased out by 2030, and key establishment must be migrated by end-2030.

milestones.title: EU PFHxA restriction hits textiles, food paper, cosmetics

research.what: Germany filed a REACH Annex XV dossier with ECHA on 20 December 2019. It proposed limiting PFHxA, its salts and related substances, which are used in textile, paper and foam treatments.

change.what: Under Regulation (EU) 2024/2462, concentration limits became binding on 10 October 2026. They cover consumer clothing and footwear, food-contact paper and board, consumer mixtures and cosmetics. The limits are 25 ppb for PFHxA and its salts and 1,000 ppb for related substances.

milestones.title: First approved PROTAC protein degrader (vepdegestrant)

research.what: The PROTAC concept was introduced as a way to tag a chosen protein for destruction by recruiting an E3 ubiquitin ligase to it. change.what: The US FDA approved Veppanu (vepdegestrant) on 1 May 2026 for ESR1-mutated ER+/HER2- advanced breast cancer, the first approval of any PROTAC, with a companion diagnostic.

milestones.note: It validates targeted protein degradation as a drug modality, moving from lab concept to a marketed medicine in about 25 years. The approval predates the 21-day window, but commentary on it is still appearing.

milestones.title: Merkle Tree Certificates for post-quantum HTTPS

research.what: Google and Cloudflare engineers proposed Merkle Tree Certificates, which build Certificate Transparency logging into certificate issuance so that HTTPS authentication can use large post-quantum signatures with little extra overhead. Origin: IETF Internet-Draft draft-davidben-tls-merkle-tree-certs (Benjamin, O'Brien, Westerbaan, Valenta, Valsorda), first published 2023; now the IETF PLANTS working-group draft, revision -07 dated 7 October 2026

change.what: Google plans to launch a Chrome Quantum-resistant Root Store that accepts only Merkle Tree Certificates in Q3 2027, after bootstrapping public MTCs with Certificate Transparency log operators in Q1 2027; test-root-store instructions were updated in October 2026.

milestones.note: Chrome has said it will not put post-quantum X.509 certificates in its public root store, so MTCs are likely to become the main way the web PKI gets quantum-resistant authentication.

milestones.title: Statistical watermarking of AI-generated text

research.what: Researchers showed that a language model's word choices could be nudged in a statistically detectable way, so that its text carries an invisible watermark without noticeably hurting quality. change.what: Google DeepMind began watermarking Gemini text output with SynthID in 2024. milestones.note: Invisible text watermarks have gone from a research idea to a tool that major AI providers use to meet the EU AI Act's machine-readable marking duty.
